name: Coconut Smoothie
desc:
Drops 10 splashes of Coconut Milk.
Coconut Milk has 30% Instant Conversion.
When stepping on Coconut Milk, receive Coconut Smoothie Boost for 15s
 (+25% Movespeed and x1.45 Obsidian Pollen).
Activates Every 15 Coconuts.

name: Sun Eclipse
desc:
Creates 4 Sunny Beams, which gather Pollen
 (boosted by Daytime Pollen during the day).
Additionally, receive Sun Eclipse Boost for 20s
 (x1.5 Pollen) & All players in the field receive
 Sun Eclipse Dual Boost for 20s
 (x1.05 Pollen & x1.1 Capacity Bonus) .Activates Every 80s.

name: Coconut Harvest
desc:
Creates 3 Coconuts, which gather Pollen and
 covers flowers in Milk.
Milk has 30% Instant Conversion.
Activates Every 20s.

name: Sunny Pulse
desc:
Creates 2 Sunny Beams, which gather
Pollen for each Hydrant (boosted by Daytime Pollen during the day).
Additionally, upgrades the flowers they gather for 12s.
Activates Every 30s.

name: Coconut Storm
desc:
Creates 3 Coconuts, which gather Pollen
 and covers flowers in Obsidian.
Activates Every 15 Swings.

name: Fire Aura
desc:
Covers flowers in Fire.
Activates Every 5 Swings.

name: Ice Aura
desc:
Covers flowers in Ice.
Activates Every 5 Swings.

name: Wind Aura
desc:
Creates 2 Clouds.
Activates Every 5 Swings.

name: Nature Harvest
desc:
Creates 5 Spikes around the field,
which gather Pollen and covers flowers in Obsidian.
Additionally, upgrades the flowers they gather for 15s.
Activates every 20 Swings.

name: Nature Charge
desc:
Activates Nature Charge Aura for 5s
(x1.2 Tool Speed and x1.2 Tool Pollen).
Activates every 45 Swings.

name: Colorful Splash
desc:
Turns shape of tool into random splash color.
Activates every 20 Swings.

name: Poison Harvest
desc:
Creates 5 Spikes around the field,
t which gather Pollen and covers flowers into Poison for 14s.
tPoison collects Pollen every second.
Activates every 20s.

name: Blossom Pollenation
desc:
Creates 8 Blossom Leaves around the field,
which gather Pollen for 12s.
Additionally, upgrades the flowers they gather for 12s.
Activates every 30s.

name: Art Splashes
desc:
Creates 3 colorful splashes randomly on field you stand on.
Activates every 30s.

name: Sticker Hunter
desc:
Creates random sticker on field & creates splash on that place.
Activates every 360s.

name: Constellation Smasher
desc:
Every 5 swings a star is placed on the field in front of you.
When 5 stars are placed they connect and detonate, collecting every flower inside the constellation and granting x2 Bubble Pollen for 20s.

name: Garden Tiller
desc: Every 5 swings, tills the flowers in front of you, restoring flower size, briefly upgrading 1-2 flowers, and collecting a bonus burst with +20% Instant Conversion.

name: Giant Weed
desc:
Break 50 vines in the field where your Pumpkin Sprinkler is placed and a Giant Weed grows there for 2 minutes.
Stay near it to link and receive Giant Weed Link
 (+25% Instant Conversion, +50% White Pollen, +50% Bomb Pollen, +10% Movespeed, +5% Bee Ability Rate, +25% Pollen).
Cooldown: 3 minutes.

name: Gourd Shield
desc:
When you take damage, a pumpkin shield surrounds you for 60s and grants Gourd Shield Boost
 (+30% Defense, +5 Red Bee Attack, +10% Critical Power, +10% Critical Chance, x1.25 Soul Fire Pollen, x1.25 Soul Duration).
Cooldown: 2 minutes.

name: Heavy Impact
desc: Every 5 swings, slams the ground for a heavy shockwave that gathers 35% bonus Tool Pollen with +20% Instant Conversion.

name: Magnetic Pulse
desc: Every 4 swings, emits a magnetic pulse that automatically collects 1-2 of your nearby Tokens in the field.

name: Meteor Summon
desc: Every 100 swings a meteor crashes into the field in front of you, covering it in magma that gathers pollen (boosted by Fire Pollen).

name: Moon Boost
desc:
Every 80s a moon appears over your head for 20s.
It pulls in your tokens nearby like a magnet and has a 15% chance to duplicate each one.

name: Nectar Splash
desc: Every 6 swings, splashes nectar across the stamp, regrowing flowers, collecting a bonus splash with +25% Instant Conversion, and energizing up to 3 nearby Bees.

name: Precision Snip
desc: Every 3 snips on full-grown flowers, performs a guaranteed Critical Snip for bonus pollen with +25% Instant Conversion.

name: Primal Rage
desc: Every 150s your other boosts stop running out for 15s.

name: Primordial Fire
desc:
Every 150 Soul Fire flowers, summon a 3x3 square of green Primordial Fire for 10s.
Primordial Fire gathers twice as much as Soul Fire, and fires it touches turn Primordial and reset their duration.
Cooldown: 2 minutes.

name: Reaper's Sweep
desc: Every 4 swings while moving, unleashes a sweeping slash that gathers 35% bonus Tool Pollen as a guaranteed Critical Hit.

name: Stardust
desc:
Creates a purple Stardust Bubble around you for 60s.
Its capacity equals your current capacity (not affected by Bubble Capacity) and it turns into honey when it pops.
Cooldown: 180s.

name: Starseed
desc:
Creates a starflower on field!
Activates every 180s.

name: Time Rend
desc:
Overclocks all Cogs in your field, extending their duration by 25%.
Flowers inside Overclocked Cogs do not degrade.
Standing inside an Overclocked Cog grants Overclock Boost.
Activates every 30 Swings.

name: Time Stop
desc:
Collecting a Timekeeper Bee token has a 1% chance (+0.5% per Timekeeper token since the last activation) to stop time for 7s.
Your screen turns grey, enemies are slowed by 50% and you receive Time Stop Boost
 (+50% Movespeed, x0.5 Bee Movespeed, +100% Tool Speed, x2 White Pollen, x2 Bomb Pollen).
All pollen collected during Time Stop is instantly converted into honey when it ends, and all tokens collected activate at once.
Cooldown: 2 minutes.

name: Time Stream
desc:
Every 2 minutes in a field, a golden point appears. Reach it in time to gain a Time Stream stack and spawn the next point with 0.5s less time.
Miss a point and you lose a stack. Smaller fields give less time.
Time Stream (stacks 10x): +2% Movespeed, +1.5% Instant Conversion, +7.5% White Pollen, +5% Bomb Pollen per stack. Lasts 5s per stack.

name: Winged Grace
desc:
Grants Winged Grace Boost for 20s
 (x1.5 Pollen, x1.1 Capacity Bonus, +10% Movespeed).
Activates Every 60s.
